opportunities.title: Holiday cups to Rewards, 2027 run
opportunities.what_is_happening: Starbucks launched 2026 holiday cups and Bearista merch nationwide Nov. 5; Rewards hit a record 36 million 90-day active U.S. members.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Holiday cups reach every customer, but nothing on the cup turns non-members into Rewards first-party contacts.
opportunities.confidence_why: Two agreeing signals; food-and-beverage packaging case study fits.
opportunities.size_why: Nationwide holiday cups tied to a 36M-member program.
opportunities.timing_why: 2026 cups already in stores; pitch the 2027 run.
opportunities.suggested_play: Print a Flowcode on 2027 holiday cups and Bearista merch tags leading to a holiday FlowHub; Smart Rules send members to offers and non-members to Rewards enrollment, synced to CRM.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the Loyalty Program lead when 2027 holiday cup artwork locks; pitch on-cup Rewards enrollment.

play.name: On-pack conversion funnel
play.play: Put a Flowcode on the pack that leads to a FlowHub (sweepstakes, recipe, game, store locator). Capture each scanner into FlowID and sync to the CRM. The code's destination can change after printing, so one print run supports later campaigns.

products.name: Flowcodes
products.page_quote: Drive conversions in the real world with the #1 Enterprise QR code.
products.what_it_does: Dynamic, branded QR codes for physical touchpoints. The destination can be changed after printing. Every code is measured on its own and by location.
products.use_when: The brand has a physical or broadcast touchpoint (pack, shelf, display, OOH, TV spot, venue signage, merch) with no measurable digital next step.

products.name: FlowHubs
products.page_quote: Deliver personalized offers, apps, promotions, and sponsor ads straight from your brand ecosystem.
products.what_it_does: Mobile landing pages and campaign hubs, built from templates or fully custom. Routes each visitor to the right offer, content or action.
products.use_when: A campaign has several destinations (sweepstakes, recipe, store locator, app, sponsor offer) and needs one branded mobile destination.

products.name: FlowID & Personalization
products.page_quote: Build a persistent first-party identity from every Flowcode, FlowURL, and FlowHub connection.
products.what_it_does: Persistent first-party identity, two-way CRM sync, Smart Rules that route by loyalty tier, LTV or audience, and Audience Builder.
products.use_when: The brand has a loyalty, rewards or CRM program, or a touchpoint that reaches people but captures no first-party data.

case_study.what_they_did: Flowcodes on snack packaging led to a 'Snap, Scan, Win' giveaway, CRM sign-up and online purchase.

opportunities.title: Perfect Harmony holiday TV spot
opportunities.what_is_happening: Starbucks' 2026 US holiday TV spot "Perfect Harmony" is a 30-second Anomaly animation paired with a seven-track Holiday Blend album.
opportunities.why_flowcode: The spot has no scannable next step, so Starbucks cannot measure which networks drive action.
opportunities.confidence_why: Single trade-press source; tentpole TV case study matches well.
opportunities.timing_why: Holiday flight still airing; an end card can be added.
opportunities.suggested_play: Add a Flowcode end card leading to a FlowHub to stream the Holiday Blend album and find holiday drinks; track scans by network and creative to shift remaining holiday spend.
opportunities.first_step: Contact the Media lead about adding a scannable end card to remaining holiday flights.

play.name: Scannable TV and broadcast spots
play.play: Put a Flowcode in the spot that leads to shop, content or a sweepstakes. Use analytics to see which creative and which network drove scans, then shift media spend.

opportunities.title: Toulouse FC matchday fan capture
opportunities.what_is_happening: Starbucks became an Official Partner of Ligue 1 club Toulouse FC, with its logo on the men's shirt sleeve and academy kits.
opportunities.why_flowcode: A sleeve logo builds awareness but gives Starbucks no first-party fan data.
opportunities.confidence_why: Single trade-press source; in-arena pro sports case fits.
opportunities.timing_why: Partnership began September; season matchdays remain open.
opportunities.suggested_play: Place Flowcodes on stadium signage and live reads leading to a Starbucks FlowHub with a matchday drink offer and sweepstakes; FlowID captures fans, Smart Rules block duplicates.
opportunities.first_step: Reach the Sponsorships lead with a matchday activation concept for upcoming Toulouse home games.

play.name: Event and sponsorship capture
play.play: Put Flowcodes on signage, merch, tickets and activations that lead to a sponsor FlowHub. Use Smart Rules to block duplicate entries, and keep every fan as a first-party contact instead of leaving them with the rights holder.

opportunities.title: Bearista pop-up, Singapore malls
opportunities.what_is_happening: Starbucks runs a travelling Bearista Holiday Experience pop-up across CapitaLand malls, unlocked with a reward code in the CapitaStar app.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Unlocks run through the mall's app, so entrants become CapitaLand data, not Starbucks contacts.
opportunities.confidence_why: Secondary source; Feld multi-location activation is a close analogy.
opportunities.timing_why: Live and travelling now; signage can change between stops.
opportunities.suggested_play: Give each mall stop its own Flowcode leading to a Bearista FlowHub that unlocks the experience; FlowID captures entrants, Smart Rules block repeats, analytics compare malls.
opportunities.first_step: Contact Starbucks Singapore marketing to propose Flowcode signage at the next mall stop.
